caseName: Larmanger v. Kaiser Found. Health Plan of the Nw.
caseNameFull: Kimerie LARMANGER v. KAISER FOUNDATION HEALTH PLAN OF the NORTHWEST, dba Kaiser Permanente

opinions.text: Motion of petitioner for leave to proceed in forma pauperisdenied. Petitioner allowed until April 13, 2015, within which to pay the docketing fee required by Rule 38(a) and to submit a petition in compliance with Rule 33.1 of the Rules of this Court.
